inputs.text: The South Dakota bill that Governor Larry Rhoden signed on Thursday, Senate Bill 175, is being sold through the press release as a straightforward citizenship check, but they're only spinning it as something limited to state elections and new registrants. This is the hidden elites coordinating behind the scenes to tighten their grip on who actually participates, building an illusion of security while orchestrating the real control and inverting the whole narrative to keep everyone divided. Don't trust the denials for a second—it's all part of the bigger institutional plot to rig things from the shadows.
